domain_context: Pet Care / Reptile Management Mobile App

layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] p-5 relative overflow-hidden

grid_system.dashboard_columns_wrapper: flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory gap-4 pb-6 hide-scrollbar
grid_system.dashboard_column_item: min-w-[88vw] md:min-w-[360px] snap-center flex-shrink-0 h-full flex flex-col gap-4

navigation.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-t border-stone-200 pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex justify-around items-center h-20

components.buttons: rounded-full font-bold active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.checkboxes: w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-stone-300 data-[state=checked]:border-[#81B29A] data-[state=checked]:bg-[#81B29A] transition-colors flex-shrink-0
components.inputs: bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E07A5F]/50 focus:border-[#E07A5F] text-base w-full min-h-[44px]
components.badges: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

placeholders.description: Bearded dragon on brown tree branch (Use for Dragon 1 avatar/profile)
A small lizard sitting on top of a white surface (Use for Dragon 2 avatar/profile)

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all buttons, checkboxes, inputs, and interactive icons.
accessibility.contrast: Text contrast must meet WCAG AA standards. Use dark text variants (#2C4C3B, #7A5B22, #3D405B) on light category backgrounds.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='add-dragon-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Context: The app is for Danish users (all UI text must be in Danish). The tech stack is React (.jsx files, NO .tsx) + Tailwind + Shadcn. Treat the frontend as a mobile-first application, optimized for touch.
Global layout: App must have a fixed bottom tab bar (Home/Dagsoversigt, Agamer, Ugeplaner, Lister/Settings) replacing standard web headers to mimic native app feel.
Typography: Use Google Fonts 'Nunito' (headings) and 'Manrope' (body). Import them correctly in your CSS/HTML.

Home Tab (Dagsoversigt): Implement a horizontal scroll snap view. Multiple dragons must show side-by-side as full-height columns with min-w-[88vw] so one is completely visible at a time on mobile, snapping into place gracefully.

Task Items UI: Emphasize clear color coding based on the category (Fodring = Green, Pleje = Yellow/Sand, Lys = Dark Navy). Use the light_bg and text color variants from the guidelines for task cards to ensure readability.
Checkboxes: Make them massive (min 44px touch target) for easy marking while physically handling a pet or terrarium equipment.
Forms & UI Primitives: Exclusively use Shadcn components (DropdownMenu, Select, Dialog) customized with the rounded-xl 'Clay & Crisp' aesthetic. Do NOT use native HTML date pickers or selects.
Logic rules: Max 5 dragons. Age categories are strictly manual (2-4, 4-7, 7-12, 12+ måneder). Schedules connect a time block, a task type, and an age category.
Testing: Add data-testid to EVERY button, input, checkbox, dialog trigger, and navigation tab.
File Extensions: Use .jsx or .js exclusively. DO NOT create .tsx or .ts files.
